title: Gameplay Overview

list.name: game_id
list.query: SELECT DISTINCT game_id FROM telemetry.events_deduplicated ORDER BY game_id

list.name: environment
list.query: SELECT DISTINCT environment FROM telemetry.events_deduplicated ORDER BY environment

list.name: build_version
list.query: SELECT '__latest__' AS __value, 'Latest reporting build' AS __text UNION ALL SELECT build_version AS __value, build_version AS __text FROM (SELECT build_version, max(timestamp) AS last_seen FROM telemetry.events_deduplicated WHERE game_id=${game_id:sqlstring} AND environment=${environment:sqlstring} GROUP BY build_version ORDER BY last_seen DESC, build_version DESC)
list.label: Build
list.description: Latest event timestamp for this game/environment, across sources and outside the time picker. Select a version to pin history.

list.name: source_type
list.query: SELECT DISTINCT source_type FROM telemetry.events_deduplicated ORDER BY source_type

targets.rawSql: SELECT uniqExact(session_id) AS sessions, countIf(event_name='run_started') AS runs_started, countIf(event_name='encounter_completed') AS encounters_completed FROM telemetry.events_deduplicated WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp) AND game_id=${game_id:sqlstring} AND environment=${environment:sqlstring} AND build_version=if(${build_version:sqlstring}='__latest__', (SELECT build_version FROM telemetry.events_deduplicated WHERE game_id=${game_id:sqlstring} AND environment=${environment:sqlstring} GROUP BY build_version ORDER BY max(timestamp) DESC, build_version DESC LIMIT 1), ${build_version:sqlstring}) AND source_type=${source_type:sqlstring} AND (1)

panels.title: Encounter win rate
panels.description: Wins / completed encounters. No completed encounters displays no data.

targets.rawSql: SELECT if(count()=0, NULL, countIf(JSONExtractString(properties,'outcome')='win') / count()) AS win_rate FROM telemetry.events_deduplicated WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp) AND game_id=${game_id:sqlstring} AND environment=${environment:sqlstring} AND build_version=if(${build_version:sqlstring}='__latest__', (SELECT build_version FROM telemetry.events_deduplicated WHERE game_id=${game_id:sqlstring} AND environment=${environment:sqlstring} GROUP BY build_version ORDER BY max(timestamp) DESC, build_version DESC LIMIT 1), ${build_version:sqlstring}) AND source_type=${source_type:sqlstring} AND (event_name='encounter_completed')

panels.title: Session and run lifecycle over time
panels.description: Counts per adaptive time bucket; empty buckets have no bar.

targets.rawSql: SELECT $__timeInterval(timestamp) AS time, event_name, count() AS events FROM telemetry.events_deduplicated WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp) AND game_id=${game_id:sqlstring} AND environment=${environment:sqlstring} AND build_version=if(${build_version:sqlstring}='__latest__', (SELECT build_version FROM telemetry.events_deduplicated WHERE game_id=${game_id:sqlstring} AND environment=${environment:sqlstring} GROUP BY build_version ORDER BY max(timestamp) DESC, build_version DESC LIMIT 1), ${build_version:sqlstring}) AND source_type=${source_type:sqlstring} AND (event_name IN ('session_started','session_ended','run_started','run_completed','floor_completed')) GROUP BY time, event_name ORDER BY time, event_name

panels.title: Encounter outcomes over time
panels.description: Counts per adaptive time bucket; empty buckets have no bar.

targets.rawSql: SELECT $__timeInterval(timestamp) AS time, JSONExtractString(properties,'outcome') AS outcome, count() AS encounters FROM telemetry.events_deduplicated WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp) AND game_id=${game_id:sqlstring} AND environment=${environment:sqlstring} AND build_version=if(${build_version:sqlstring}='__latest__', (SELECT build_version FROM telemetry.events_deduplicated WHERE game_id=${game_id:sqlstring} AND environment=${environment:sqlstring} GROUP BY build_version ORDER BY max(timestamp) DESC, build_version DESC LIMIT 1), ${build_version:sqlstring}) AND source_type=${source_type:sqlstring} AND (event_name='encounter_completed') GROUP BY time, outcome ORDER BY time, outcome

SELECT concat('Floor ', toString(JSONExtractInt(properties,'floor'))) AS floor, count() AS completions FROM telemetry.events_deduplicated WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp) AND game_id=${game_id:sqlstring} AND environment=${environment:sqlstring} AND build_version=if(${build_version:sqlstring}='__latest__', (SELECT build_version FROM telemetry.events_deduplicated WHERE game_id=${game_id:sqlstring} AND environment=${environment:sqlstring} GROUP BY build_version ORDER BY max(timestamp) DESC, build_version DESC LIMIT 1), ${build_version:sqlstring}) AND source_type=${source_type:sqlstring} AND (event_name='floor_completed') GROUP BY JSONExtractInt(properties,'floor') ORDER BY JSONExtractInt(properties,'floor') LIMIT 100

description: Defaults to the latest reporting build for the selected game/environment, across sources. Historical builds remain selectable. Panels respect the selected time range and source unless labeled global.
